summary: Nasus Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 9, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing positive preclinical results for its intranasal ondansetron formulation (NS003) and an updated corporate presentation. No special-situation corporate action is disclosed: the filing is a routine update of clinical trial progress, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The registrant is the issuer filing a routine progress report.
